num-to-chinese.intro: Number-to-Chinese tool that converts Arabic numerals to Chinese uppercase amounts and vice versa, supporting decimals and negative numbers. Ideal for finance, contracts and other scenarios
num-to-chinese.num2cnHint: Supports up to 16 integer digits (about 9999 trillion), with a maximum of two decimal places
num-to-chinese.num2cnNote: Note: Supports integer and decimal conversion, up to the trillion digit, keeping at most two decimal places. Negative numbers are converted to Chinese uppercase with a leading "negative". "Yuan" is added before the decimal point, and the decimal parts use "jiao" and "fen".
num-to-chinese.cn2numNote: Note: Converts Chinese uppercase numerals to Arabic numerals. "元", "圆" and "点" are unified into decimal points, and quantifiers such as "角" and "分" are automatically parsed as decimal places. The result keeps two decimal places.

text-transform.noteRule1: Case conversion only affects English letters; Chinese characters are unaffected.
text-transform.noteRule2: Capitalization treats spaces, punctuation, etc. as word separators.
text-transform.noteRule3: Title case follows English title conventions, keeping short words such as a, an, the, in, on lowercase.
text-transform.notePerf1: We recommend processing no more than 100,000 characters at a time.
text-transform.notePerf2: Large texts may take longer to process; please be patient.
text-transform.notePerf3: For frequent conversions, consider processing in batches.
text-transform.noteFaq1: Conversion has no effect: Check whether the text contains letters.
text-transform.noteFaq2: Abnormal result: Check whether the input text format is correct.
text-transform.noteFaq3: Copy failed: Check whether your browser allows clipboard access.
text-transform.noteFaq4: Out of memory: Reduce the text content or process it in batches.

timestamp.title: Timestamp Converter
timestamp.intro: Unix timestamp and date-time conversion tool with second/millisecond precision switching, live current timestamp display, timezone selection and multiple date format outputs
timestamp.problem2: Simplify tedious manual operations, improving efficiency and accuracy.
timestamp.problem3: Use it online anytime, anywhere, without installing professional software.
timestamp.formatTs: Timestamp: Full processing supported for this format.
timestamp.formatDt: Date-time: Full processing supported for this format.
timestamp.featureOnline: Online Processing: All operations run in your browser — no downloads or installation needed.
timestamp.featurePreview: Real-time Preview: Results appear instantly so you can adjust and confirm.
timestamp.featureExport: One-click Export: Quickly export the processed result or copy it.
timestamp.featureSecurity: Data Security: All data is processed locally and never uploaded to any server.
timestamp.usageInputTs: Enter timestamp: Type a Unix timestamp (numeric) into the input box.
timestamp.usageSelectUnit: Select unit: Switch between second/millisecond precision; the tool auto-detects.
timestamp.usageClickConvert: Convert: Click the "Convert" button or press Enter to convert.
timestamp.usageUseCurrent: One-click now: Click the "Use Current Time" button to use the current timestamp.
timestamp.usageLiveDisplay: Live display: The top of the page shows the current timestamp (in seconds) in real time.
timestamp.usageSelectDate: Select date: Use the date picker to choose a date and time.
timestamp.usageSelectTz: Select timezone: Choose the target timezone (defaults to local timezone).
timestamp.usageConvert: Convert: Click the "Convert" button to generate the timestamp.
timestamp.usageResult: Result: Displays both second-level and millisecond-level timestamps.
timestamp.usageAutoDetect: Auto-detection: The tool infers the precision from the number of digits.
timestamp.usageTzLocal: Local timezone: Uses the browser's timezone by default.
timestamp.usageTzUtc: UTC: Coordinated Universal Time, unaffected by daylight saving time.
timestamp.usageTzOther: Other timezones: Supports various timezones, such as Beijing Time (UTC+8).
timestamp.usageTipLive: Live update: The timestamp at the top updates every second.
timestamp.usageTipCopy: One-click copy: Click the "Copy" button to copy the timestamp or conversion result.
timestamp.usageTipSwitchTab: Switch tabs: Click the tabs to switch the conversion direction.
timestamp.usageTipFormats: Common formats: The result offers multiple date formats for copying.
timestamp.usageScenarioDebug: Development & debugging: Look up the concrete time of timestamps in logs.
timestamp.usageScenarioApi: API development: Generate or parse timestamp-style API parameters.
timestamp.noteSecurity1: All processing is done entirely in your local browser; data is never uploaded to a server.
timestamp.noteSecurity2: Timestamp data is processed only in browser memory and is cleared automatically when you close the page.
timestamp.noteSecurity3: Use private browsing mode when handling sensitive time data.
timestamp.notePrecision1: Second-level precision: accurate to the second, suitable for most scenarios.
timestamp.notePrecision2: Millisecond-level precision: accurate to the millisecond, for scenarios requiring high precision.
timestamp.notePrecision3: 13-digit input is treated as milliseconds automatically; 10-digit input is treated as seconds.
timestamp.noteTz1: When converting timestamps to dates, the local timezone is used by default.
timestamp.noteTz2: When converting dates to timestamps, the selected timezone affects the result.
timestamp.noteTz3: UTC and local time may differ by 8 hours (Beijing Time).
timestamp.noteTz4: Daylight saving time may affect results for some timezones.
timestamp.noteRange1: Supported range: January 1, 1970 to January 19, 2038 (Unix timestamp range).
timestamp.noteRange2: Timestamps outside this range may not convert correctly.
timestamp.noteRange3: Negative timestamps represent times before January 1, 1970.
timestamp.noteFaq1: Conversion error: Check that the input is purely numeric.
timestamp.noteFaq2: Abnormal time display: Check that the timezone selection is correct.
timestamp.noteFaq3: Precision error: Confirm whether second or millisecond precision is being used.
timestamp.noteFaq4: Copy failed: Check whether your browser allows clipboard access.
timestamp.errInvalidTs: Invalid timestamp format, please enter numbers only
timestamp.errInvalidDate: Unable to parse as valid date
